login.intro: Sign in with your school account. Access is granted by your school administrator.
login.error: Sign-in did not complete ({error}). Please try again.
login.devNotice: Development sign-in (AUTH_DEV_BYPASS). Not available in production.
login.devHelp: Demo roles come from `pnpm --filter @edupro/db seed:demo`; each subject shows the app from that role’s viewpoint.

dashboard.adminText: Navigation on the left is generated from your effective permissions. Module screens arrive sprint by sprint: access, communication, reports and people are available now.

students.title: Students
students.description: Students of the working year with their current section. Class teachers see their own sections.
students.search: Search by name or admission number

create.title: Admit a student
create.identityHelp: The admission number is unique per school and cannot change later.
create.guardianHelp: A guardian with the same mobile number is reused, so siblings share one guardian record.
create.enrolmentHelp: Places the student in a section of the working year.

students.idCardHelp: The card is rendered in the background and appears in the export centre.
students.changeStatusHelp: Deactivating keeps the record and every enrolment; the reason is stored with the change.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Staff records with their posting in the working year: department, designation, campus and reporting line.
employees.postingHelp: One posting per academic year. Saving again updates it.

search.title: Find a person
search.description: Name, admission number, employee code or mobile number. Results respect your permissions and class scopes.
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}

academics_classes.title: Classes and sections
academics_classes.description: Master classes for this school. Sections are defined per academic year.

access_assignments_detail.description: Scopes limit this assignment to specific sections. No scope means the role applies to every section.
access_assignments_detail.descriptionTeacher: This role came with the staff login or from Teacher assignments: it reaches only the sections ticked here (Academics → Teacher assignments sets them), and with none ticked no section.

access_assignments.title: Role assignments
access_assignments.description: Who holds which role, with validity and data scopes. Granting needs a recent multi-factor sign-in and is checked for segregation of duties.

access_delegations.title: Delegations
access_delegations.description: Hand a role you hold to a colleague for a fixed period, for example leave cover. Actions taken under a delegation record both people.

access_memberships.title: Members
access_memberships.description: People who can sign in to this school. Invite by mobile number or One Auth subject; the account is claimed on first sign-in.

access_roles.title: Roles and permissions
access_roles.description: System templates are read-only. School roles are yours to shape; every change is audited.

comms_messages.title: Delivery log
comms_messages.description: Every message with its provider outcome. Failed deliveries retry automatically with backoff before they are marked failed.

reports_exports.title: Export centre
reports_exports.description: Files are generated in the background and kept for seven days. Reload to see progress.

system_audit.title: Audit log
system_audit.description: Every mutation and privileged action, written in the same transaction as the change. Newest first; the grid holds the latest 200 rows for the filter.

system_jobs.title: Background jobs
system_jobs.description: Jobs leave the transactional outbox for the worker queues. Failed rows stay here as the dead-letter list until retried.

system_settings.title: School settings
system_settings.description: Typed settings with a validity date. Procedures such as the late-fee rule read these values directly.

system_years.title: Academic and financial years
system_years.description: Years are dimensions: activate the next one, lock stages as they close, and never copy master data.

academics_subjects.title: Subjects
academics_subjects.description: Subject master for this school and the subjects each class studies in the working year.

academics_teacher_assignments.title: Teacher assignments
academics_teacher_assignments.description: Who teaches what. Each assignment grants the teacher's role and limits it to the assigned sections.

academics_timetable.title: Timetable
academics_timetable.description: Periods of the school day and the weekly timetable of every section. A teacher cannot be in two sections in one period.

people_import.title: Bulk import
people_import.description: Upload a CSV of students or employees. The file is validated first; nothing is written until you commit a clean file.

academics_daily_work.title: Daily work
academics_daily_work.description: Homework, classwork and assignments by section. Teachers post for their own sections; families see their children's.

academics_notices.title: Notices and circulars
academics_notices.description: Published notices reach their audience and targets in the parent and teacher apps; drafts stay here.

academics_calendar.title: Holidays and almanac
academics_calendar.description: Holidays block attendance and alerts; almanac events appear in every app's calendar.

academics_gallery.title: Gallery
academics_gallery.description: Albums of school events. Images go through the file service.

people_tc.title: Transfer certificates
people_tc.description: Numbered per school. Issuing ends the student's enrolment; the PDF comes from the school's TC template.

people_withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
people_withdrawals.description: Two steps: a request opens one clearance per department; completion is possible once every department has cleared.

people_promotions.title: Promotion
people_promotions.description: Record a decision per student, then apply the pending decisions into next year's enrolments.

system_templates.title: Document templates
system_templates.description: HTML templates with placeholders for transfer certificates, bonafide certificates and letters.

admissions_dashboard.title: Admissions dashboard
admissions_dashboard.description: Applications by status and class against seats; possible duplicates to review.

admissions_cycles.title: Admission sessions
admissions_cycles.description: Each session takes registrations into one academic year. Open a session to set its classes, registration forms, seats and fees.

admissions_applications.title: Applications
admissions_applications.description: The intake desk: review, shortlist, score and decide.

fees_masters.title: Fee masters
fees_masters.description: Heads, the twelve periods of the year with instalments, transport slabs and discounts.

fees_structures.title: Class fee structure
fees_structures.description: Amount per head and frequency for each class of the working year.

fees_demands.title: Fee demands
fees_demands.description: Generate the year's demand for a class (the legacy GenerateFee rules) and see per-student totals.

workflow_inbox.title: My inbox
workflow_inbox.description: Requests waiting for your decision at the current level.

workflow_instances.title: Requests
workflow_instances.description: Every approval request with its levels and decisions.

workflow_definitions.title: Workflows
workflow_definitions.description: Approval chains per entity: levels and who resolves each level.

fees_payments.title: Payments
fees_payments.description: Online intents from the gateway and counter receipts, allocated to the oldest dues first.

attendance_dashboard.title: Day summary
attendance_dashboard.description: Every section for a date: marked or not, present, absent and late.

attendance_register.title: Register
attendance_register.description: Mark or correct a section for a date; lock it when the day is closed.

attendance_rfid.title: RFID readers
attendance_rfid.description: Gate readers, their keys and the tap log.

comms_compose.title: Compose a message
comms_compose.description: Pick the template and the audience, preview who receives it, then send it for approval.

comms_requests.title: Message requests
comms_requests.description: Requests with their approval status and delivery counts.

comms_groups.title: Groups
comms_groups.description: Named sets of members a message can target (PTA, bus parents, committees).

comms_consents.title: Consent records
comms_consents.description: DPDP purposes per person: what was granted or withdrawn, when, and by whom.

engagement_queries.title: Queries, complaints and leave
engagement_queries.description: Raised by families from the parent app; class teachers see their sections.

engagement_feedback.title: Feedback
engagement_feedback.description: Ratings and comments from families, averaged per area.

engagement_change_requests.title: Profile change requests
engagement_change_requests.description: Changes families asked for; approval applies them with an audit row.

transport_routes.title: Routes
transport_routes.description: Bus routes with vehicles, drivers and the students riding them this year.

attendance_rfid_dashboard.title: RFID dashboard
attendance_rfid_dashboard.description: Reader health, gate and bus counts, and tagged students who have not come in.

attendance_bus.title: Bus attendance
attendance_bus.description: Boarding and alighting taps per route with guardian alerts.

attendance_punches.title: Staff punches
attendance_punches.description: First in, last out and hours per employee from the biometric devices.

academics_substitutions.title: Substitutions
academics_substitutions.description: Cover for absent teachers: pick the section and period, see who is free, assign.

academics_lesson_plans.title: Lesson plans
academics_lesson_plans.description: Weekly plans by teachers; approvals run through Coordinator, Vice Principal and Principal.

attendance_rules.title: Student rules
attendance_rules.description: Per-student late time and alert muting for the working year (RFID rules v2).

system_privacy.title: Privacy notice
system_privacy.description: The DPDP notice families acknowledge in the parent app, the data-principal request queue, the nightly retention purge and the breach log.

fees_ledger.title: Student fee ledger
fees_ledger.description: Instalments with the late fee rule, receipts with numbers, overrides and the last regeneration diff. Switch the year in the header to read a previous session.

transport_vehicles.title: Vehicles
transport_vehicles.description: Buses and vans with insurance, fitness and permit expiries and the routes they run.

transport_drivers.title: Drivers
transport_drivers.description: Drivers with licence details and the routes they drive.

insights_principal.title: Principal dashboard
insights_principal.description: Today's school on one page: attendance, fees, admissions, communication, approvals and readers, computed from the reporting marts.

fees_cashier.title: Cashier
fees_cashier.description: Find the student, see what is payable today and post the receipt in one step: principal, late fee and any advance.

fees_refunds.title: Refunds
fees_refunds.description: Refund requests from the accounts desk; an administrator approves and pays out, or rejects.

fees_settlements.title: Gateway settlements
fees_settlements.description: Upload the payment gateway's payout file; every line is matched to an online receipt.

transport_requests.title: Bus requests
transport_requests.description: Families ask for a seat, a stop change or to leave the bus; decide here or in the approval inbox when the workflow is on.

transport_vehicle_logs.title: Vehicle log
transport_vehicle_logs.description: Odometer, fuel, trips and incidents per day.

insights_departments.title: Department dashboards
insights_departments.description: One dashboard and one report centre per department, open to whoever holds that department's permissions.

insights_department.title: Department dashboard
insights_department.description: Numbers from the reporting marts and the module tables for the working session.

fees_adjustments.title: Adjustments
fees_adjustments.description: Requests raised by the accounts desk: fee waiver, receipt cancellation and cheque bounce. All of them go through Fee setup → Approval levels and are approved from My approvals; this page shows each request, who it waits with and how it ended.

fees_misc.title: Misc receipts
fees_misc.description: Receipts on the misc ledger for students, employees, vendors and others.

exams_masters.title: Types and grade scales
exams_masters.description: Exam types with weightage and the grade scales with their bands.

exams_list.title: Exams of the session
exams_list.description: Exams per class with dates, subjects, max marks and entry locks.

exams_detail.title: Exam
exams_detail.description: Classes, subjects with max and pass marks, and locks.

fees_reports.title: Reports centre
fees_reports.description: Day book, head-wise tally, defaulters with reminders, forecast and the Tally export; every report is the same definition on screen and in the file.

fees_bank.title: Bank statements
fees_bank.description: Upload the bank's statement; credits are matched to cheque, DD, NEFT and UPI receipts and returned cheques are flagged for a bounce adjustment.

insights_alerts.title: Alerts
insights_alerts.description: Anomalies found nightly: attendance drops per section, collection dips, silent RFID readers. Acknowledge what you have handled.

fees_shadow.title: Variance workbench
fees_shadow.description: The shadow run: legacy receipts fed in daily are posted into the new ledger and reconciled; explain or resolve every variance until the run reads zero.

system_service_keys.title: Service keys
system_service_keys.description: Machine credentials for feeds such as the legacy cron. A key is shown once when issued; revoke it here when the job retires.

exams_register.title: Mark register
exams_register.description: Pupils × subjects with totals, percentage, grade and rank, after the results are computed.

exams_analysis.title: Result analysis
exams_analysis.description: Pass rates, means, grade distribution, section comparison and toppers.

exams_promotion.title: Promotion proposals
exams_promotion.description: Promote or retain from the results under a pass rule; accepted proposals go to the promotion register of the next year.

insights_reports.title: AI reports
insights_reports.description: The Monday brief and the department weeklies, written from cited facts; the PDF is rendered by the workers and a WhatsApp summary goes to the alert roles.

insights_assistant_costs.title: Assistant costs
insights_assistant_costs.description: Spend and tokens by day, app, user and model, with the refusal rate and the budgets in force.

workflow_instance.title: Approval
workflow_instance.description: Steps, who holds them, due times, and the full history: decisions, reminders, escalations, reassignments and notes.

exams_report_cards.title: Report cards
exams_report_cards.description: Every report card of the year: an exam card (PT1, PT2 …), a term card or an annual card; a class can have several live at once. Check what is ready, make the PDFs, send a card to the principal, who publishes it class by class.

exams_report_card_templates.title: Report-card designer
exams_report_card_templates.description: One template per class band: an ordered layout of sections with options, your CSS, and optionally your own HTML body. Preview with sample data or a real pupil.

transport_gps.title: Live fleet
transport_gps.description: Last position of every bus from the GPS vendor's push (service key, scope transport.gps). Families see their child's bus on the parent app.

library.title: Books
library.description: Every title with its copies on the shelf and out. Add a book once with its copies; open a title for its copies, loans and history.

library_circulation.title: Circulation
library_circulation.description: Issue, renew and return by accession number. Loan days, the copies a borrower may hold and the fine per day come from settings.

library_fines.title: Fines
library_fines.description: Late fines go to the fees counter as misc fees when a book comes back; what is due, collected and waived, by day.

exams_board_results.title: Board results
exams_board_results.description: Import the board's result file (CBSE: one row per candidate per subject, or the compact one row per candidate). Pupils match by board roll number, else by name within the class; unmatched rows are kept by roll number.

library_stock.title: Stock verification
library_stock.description: Stock cycles over the libraries, shelves and material types chosen; books verified by scan, a file or by hand; what is missing at the close.

insights_results.title: Results analytics
insights_results.description: Pass rates and means by exam, class and section from the hourly results mart, and the subjects with the weakest pass rates.

engagement_appointments.title: Appointments
engagement_appointments.description: Parents and outside visitors book a free slot; the front desk confirms, declines or gives a new time, and the pass checks the visitor in at the gate.

engagement_visitors.title: Visitors
engagement_visitors.description: Today's visitor log: sign in with purpose and whom to meet, sign out when they leave. Id proof kind only — numbers are never stored.

engagement_gate_passes.title: Gate passes
engagement_gate_passes.description: Early leave and late arrival passes with the escort; approved passes get a number and the family a WhatsApp.

engagement_consent_forms.title: Consent forms
engagement_consent_forms.description: Build a form (text, choice, yes/no, date, signature), open it to families, read the responses; a fee opens the online pay flow.

engagement_certificates.title: Certificates
engagement_certificates.description: Issue certificates from a certificate template to a section or chosen pupils: serial numbers per pupil, one PDF for the batch, each family can download its own.

engagement_clinic.title: Clinic
engagement_clinic.description: Record a visit (complaint, treatment, temperature, referral, sent home); the family gets a WhatsApp.

engagement_cctv.title: CCTV footage requests
engagement_cctv.description: Requests for footage with camera, window and reason; decided by the school admin (approval workflow when installed).

engagement_employee_queries.title: Employee queries
engagement_employee_queries.description: Staff queries by category; answered by the coordinator (approval workflow when installed).

reports_schedules.title: Scheduled reports
reports_schedules.description: A dataset or document on a cron schedule, run as its owner by the workers; recipients get the link by WhatsApp or email.

reports_mis.title: MIS centre
reports_mis.description: The dashboards mapped to your roles, each with its numbers, its screen and its exports. The mapping is a master under System → MIS dashboards by role.

insights_group.title: Group view
insights_group.description: One row per school of the group: pupils, attendance today, fees this month and outstanding, the latest exam, open approvals, overdue library loans.

insights_assistant.title: Assistant
insights_assistant.description: Ask about the school in English or Hindi; every answer comes from a catalogue query you are allowed to run, and names it.

insights_assistant_audit.title: Assistant audit
insights_assistant_audit.description: Prompts, tool calls, answers and cost, with personal data masked.

system_cutover.title: Cut-over runs
system_cutover.description: Rehearsals and the final cut-over of the go-live runbook: every step ticked and timed, the legacy and live counts reconciled, the sign-off recorded.

system_hypercare.title: Hypercare
system_hypercare.description: Issues reported by staff during hypercare, triaged against the severity SLAs; the admins get a digest every morning.

fees_month_end.title: Month-end close
fees_month_end.description: The checks of a month, the close that locks the period and queues the month-end pack, and the period locks.

help.title: Help centre
help.description: The training pages for each module, the same routines the trainers walked through.

me_profile.title: My profile
me_profile.description: My details as the school has them; update them, download as PDF.

stepUp.title: Verify it is you
stepUp.intro: This action needs a recent multi-factor sign-in. Continue to verify with One Auth; you will return to where you were.
stepUp.devNotice: Development step-up (AUTH_DEV_BYPASS): re-signing refreshes the authentication time.

security.title: Security
security.description: Alerts from the in-process detector, impersonation sessions and break-glass windows.
security.breakGlassHelp: Emergency self-grant for at most four hours. The security lead is notified now and receives a report of every action when the window closes.
security.reasonPlaceholder: At least 20 characters: what is broken and why normal access cannot fix it

impersonationBanner.viewOnly: view only: nothing can be sent or changed
impersonationBanner.noPayments: payments, sign-in settings and sessions as others are not available

academics.name: Name
academics.classSubjectsHelp: Pick a class to see and change the subjects it studies this year.
academics.subject: Subject
academics.newAssignmentHelp: The teacher receives the matching role scoped to the section as soon as you save. Ending the last assignment revokes it.
academics.noPeriods: Define the periods of the school day first
academics.setSlotHelp: Click a cell to prefill the day and period, then choose the subject and teacher.

imports.templateHelp: Download a header row with every accepted column. Required columns are marked with an asterisk in the list below.
imports.cannotCommit: This file has rejected rows. Fix them and upload the file again.
imports.failed: The file could not be read: check the header row.

daily.subject: Subject
daily.title: Title
daily.noWork: No daily work in this range
daily.name: Name

lifecycle.search: TC number, name or admission number
lifecycle.completeHelp: Ends the enrolment, deactivates the student and their login.
lifecycle.requestHelp: Opens one clearance per department (fees, library, transport, academics).
lifecycle.applyHelp: Creates next-year enrolments for promote and retain, ends this year's enrolment for transfer out and graduate.
lifecycle.chooseClass: Choose a class and the target year

templates.name: Name
templates.noTemplates: No templates yet. Install the defaults to start.
templates.previewHelp: Rendered with sample data. Placeholders are always escaped.

admissions.name: Name
admissions.formHelp: The default form is used; field-level editing arrives with the admissions module in Sprint 9.
admissions.shortlistHelp: Moves submitted applications of the class to shortlisted, by minimum score or top count.
admissions.drawHelp: Random pick among the shortlisted for the seats left; the seed makes the draw reproducible.
admissions.admitHelp: Creates the student, links the guardian and enrols in the cycle year; needs a paid admission fee unless waived.

fees.name: Name
fees.noPeriods: No periods yet: generate them for the working year
fees.head: Head
fees.yearTotal: Year total for a regular student
fees.generateHelp: Replaces unpaid rows; rows with payments are kept.
fees.noInstalments: No demand for this year yet
fees.regenerateHelp: Re-runs the demand rules; paid rows are kept and every change is listed below.
fees.lateFeeSetupHelp: Slab amounts apply when the late fee rule is slab (System → Settings). Visible-from overrides the school-wide days-before setting.
fees.sequenceHelp: Prefix and start number can be set until the first receipt of the year is issued.

workflow.subject: Request
workflow.noDefinitions: No workflows yet; install the defaults

payments.noStudent: No student matches that admission number
payments.recorded: Receipts are allocated to the oldest dues; the student page shows the balance.

attendance.subject: Subject
attendance.keyShown: Reader key (shown once; configure it on the device as the x-device-key header):
attendance.helpCodes: P present · A absent · L late · SR short leave · H half day · OD on duty · SB stay back
attendance.alerts: Guardians of absent students receive a WhatsApp alert once.
attendance.ingest: Readers post to POST /api/v1/attendance/rfid/events with header x-device-key.
attendance.noBus: No bus taps on this date
attendance.rulesHelp: A rule overrides the school late time and stops absent and bus alerts for one student.

comms.title: Title
comms.bodyHelp: Merged into the template as {{body}}; the recipient name, student, class and school fill in automatically.

skippedReasons.no_address: no mobile or email on file

comms.openInbox: Awaiting approval in the principal’s inbox
comms.recordHelp: For a signed form at the counter. The person can change it any time in the parent app.
comms.chooseMember: Choose a member to see their consent record.

engagement.subject: Subject
engagement.replyHelp: A reply marks the query answered and notifies the family on WhatsApp.
engagement.closeHelp: Closing a leave request needs a decision.
engagement.author: From

transport.name: Route
transport.assignHelp: Pick a section, choose students and give the stop and times; a student rides one route per year.
transport.stopsHelp: Stops in running order with coordinates, times and the slab the stop falls in. Blank names are dropped.
transport.logHelp: One row per vehicle and day; saving the same day again corrects it.

planner.subject: Subject
planner.pick: Pick a section and period to see who is free.
planner.title: Title

privacy.title: Title
privacy.publishHelp: Every family sees the new version on their next visit and confirms their consent choices.

insights.sourceHelp: Every number comes from SQL over the reporting marts (refreshed every 15 minutes by the workers) plus live counts for approvals and readers.
insights.notAllowed: Needs a permission of this department
insights.exportQueued: Exports appear in the export centre when ready.

cashier.noStudent: Pick a section and a student to start.
cashier.help: The receipt settles the oldest instalment first, then its late fee; what is left becomes an advance on the receipt.
cashier.ledgerHint: Hostel receipts settle hostel instalments only.

refunds.requestHelp: An approved refund reopens the demand it came from; online receipts can be refunded through the gateway that collected them.

settlements.csvHelp: The provider's payout CSV: one line per transaction with the payment id (or order id) and the amount; fee, tax and net columns are read when present.

adjustments.help: A waiver lowers one demand row; a reversal or bounce takes the receipt out of the ledger and reopens the rows. Approval needs a recent multi-factor sign-in.

misc.head: Head
misc.help: Misc heads (ledger misc) carry ID cards, certificates, stalls and other collections; the number comes from the misc sequence of the financial year.

exams.name: Name
exams.typeCodeFixed: The code stays as it is: exams and reports refer to it. An inactive type is not offered for new exams; its exams stay.
exams.scaleHelp: Bands are percentages of max marks, highest first; they must not overlap.
exams.subject: Subject
exams.noSubjects: No subjects yet for this class
exams.subjectsHelp: One row per subject of the class; blank max marks drop the row. Locked rows keep their lock.

assistant.question: Your question
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Class VI fee defaulters above 5,000 · attendance today · कक्षा VI के बकायादार
assistant.refused: The assistant could not answer from school data.
assistant.notAllowed: needs a permission you do not hold
assistant.budgetExceeded: The assistant budget for today or this month is used up.

feeReports.exportQueued: Export queued: download it from Reports → Export centre when ready.
feeReports.head: Head
feeReports.truncated: Showing the first rows only; export for the full list.
feeReports.notified: Reminders: {sent} sent, {skipped} already sent today, {noMobile} without a mobile, {failed} failed.
feeReports.tallyHelp: One Receipt voucher per receipt: the cash or bank ledger (System → Settings, fees.tally.*) is debited and each fee head is credited. Download the XML from the Export centre and import it in Tally.

bank.fileHelp: The bank's CSV export with date, narration, reference, debit and credit columns; up to 2 MB.
bank.returnedHelp: A returned cheque is flagged only: raise the bounce under Fees → Adjustments so the approval and the charge follow the usual path.

shadow.fileHelp: CSV with the legacy column names (receipt, sadmission, ReceiptDate, fees_amount, PaymentMode, ChequeNo, BankName, FinancialYear, status) or a JSON array of rows with their lines.
shadow.serviceHint: The legacy cron posts to /api/v1/shadow/feeds/ingest with a service key (System → Service keys, scope shadow.feed).
shadow.closeHelp: The shadow run closes after three consecutive zero-variance reconciliations. A closure before that needs a reason and a second factor; both are recorded in the audit log.

serviceKeys.name: Name
serviceKeys.shadowFeed: shadow.feed — feed legacy receipts and balances
serviceKeys.shownOnce: Copy the key now; it is shown once and never again:
serviceKeys.usage: Send it as the X-Service-Key header to the feed route; rotate by issuing a new key and revoking the old one.

results.notComputed: Results have not been computed for this exam yet.
results.subject: Subject
results.record: Record decisions in the promotion register
results.recordHelp: Ticked pupils are written with their proposal (promote or retain) to People → Promotions for the chosen year; apply them there when the year opens.
results.noTarget: No planned or active year to promote into; create it under System → Years.
results.additional: Additional subject (kept out of the total)

aiReports.title: Title
aiReports.label: What it measures
aiReports.none: No reports yet; the workers write them on Monday mornings, or generate one now.

costs.budget: Budgets: {user} tokens per user per day · {school} per school per month

masters.description: Masters of this school. Add or edit a row, upload an Excel sheet to add or update many at once, export the list as Excel or PDF, and update one column on ticked rows in bulk.
masters.noRows: No rows yet. Add one, or upload a sheet.
masters.mergeTitle: Merge a duplicate into this one
masters.mergeHelp: Type to search, then pick the duplicate. {note}; the duplicate is removed.
masters.mergeSure: I have checked: the duplicate is removed once merged
masters.bulkHelp: Tick the rows in the table first; only the columns marked for bulk update are offered.
masters.cloneTitle: Clone {master} from one year to another
masters.cloneHelp: Rows whose key already exists in the target year are left untouched.

dsr.title: Title

home.1_body: The menu on the left shows only what your role may do. Groups fold; the pin collapses the menu to icons.
home.2_body: The header shows the school and the academic session you are working in; switch them there when you hold more than one.
home.3_body: Search finds pupils, guardians and staff by name, admission number or mobile. The bell lists insight alerts.
home.4_body: Every screen has this tour behind the question mark; the training pages in docs/training explain the routines.

students.1_body: Every pupil of the school with their current section. Filters narrow by class, status and more; the grid exports to Excel.
students.2_body: The profile carries guardians, documents, enrolment history, fees, attendance and status history in one place.
students.3_body: Families request corrections from the parent app; you approve them here and the audit log records both.
students.4_body: People → Bulk import validates a spreadsheet row by row before anything is written.

admissions.1_body: A session is one intake per academic year: each class gets its registration form (made in the form builder), seats, dates and a fee per category.
admissions.2_body: Candidates register on the school website, pay the registration fee and get a number; the office can also register walk-in parents.
admissions.3_body: Each class follows its stages (document check, test, interview, selection) with the approvers set in Admission set-up.
admissions.4_body: After the admission fee the office allots the section and the candidate becomes a student with parents, documents and a parent login.

academics.1_body: Classes, sections and subjects for the session; teacher assignments grant the scoped roles.
academics.2_body: Periods and slots per section; a teacher cannot be in two places in one period.
academics.3_body: Homework, classwork and assignments posted by teachers appear here and in the parent app at once.
academics.4_body: Notices target a class, a wing or the school; the almanac and holidays drive attendance and the apps.

attendance.1_body: One session per section per day, marked by the class teacher with taps from gates and buses pre-filled.
attendance.2_body: Late cut-offs, half days and per-pupil rules live under Rules; readers and their keys under Devices.
attendance.3_body: Absence alerts go once a day per pupil; the dashboard shows chronic absence and device health.

communication.1_body: SMS templates carry their DLT id; WhatsApp templates their approved name.
communication.2_body: Draft to a group, preview who receives it and who is skipped, submit for the principal's approval.
communication.3_body: General messages respect each family's consent per channel; service messages always go.
communication.4_body: Every message with its delivery status from the provider's receipts.

engagement.1_body: Family queries, complaints and leave requests routed by category with an SLA.
engagement.2_body: Requests from families reach the class teacher's inbox; approved passes get a number and a WhatsApp.
engagement.3_body: Sign visitors in and out (id kind only, never the number); record clinic visits with a family message.
engagement.4_body: Build a form with an optional fee; issue certificates from a template to a section.

fees.1_body: Heads, structures and concessions per session; demand per class; a profile change regenerates one pupil.
fees.2_body: Post receipts against the ledger; numbering and allocation are automatic; print at once.
fees.3_body: Waivers, reversals and bounces are requests with a reason; the admin approves with a second factor.
fees.4_body: Day book, head-wise tally, defaulters, forecast and the Tally export; every export lands in Reports → Exports.
fees.5_body: While the legacy system runs in parallel the workbench compares both ledgers daily and closes the run at M3.

exams.1_body: Exam types and grade scales per class band.
exams.2_body: Create the exam with classes and subjects; teachers enter marks; the coordinator locks and reopens.
exams.3_body: Compute results per exam; ranks, analysis and promotion proposals follow.
exams.4_body: Templates per band, releases per term, batch PDFs; families download their own.

workflow.1_body: Everything waiting for you: admissions, messages, lesson plans, fee changes, transport, appointments, gate passes, CCTV, employee queries.
workflow.2_body: Levels, resolvers and SLAs per flow; escalation after the SLA; delegations count.
workflow.3_body: Every instance keeps its steps, comments and events for the audit.

reports.1_body: Every Excel, CSV, PDF and XML you asked for, with its status and download link.
reports.2_body: A dataset on a cron schedule, run as you, delivered to roles or addresses.
reports.3_body: The dashboards mapped to your roles with live numbers and their exports.

masters.1_body: Every master has the same screen: list, search, add, edit, status, Excel export and bulk upload.
masters.2_body: Download the template, fill it, validate; the report lists problems per row; commit only when clean.
masters.3_body: Masters belong to the school you are working in; a group can clone a master to another school.

privacy.1_body: The DPDP notice families acknowledge; a new version asks everyone again.
privacy.2_body: Access, correction, erasure and grievance requests with their due dates; completing an access request generates the report.
privacy.3_body: The nightly purge per policy and what it removed; limits are settings within legal minimums.
privacy.4_body: Record, contain, notify the Board and the principals, close; the clock to the Board notice is shown.
